request.deadline: 12-month delivery period from August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027
Oversight metrics including balances, conversion rates, transaction hashes, and treasury repayment hashes
Eternl Core rewrite and related performance improvements
request.what: 12 months of operations, maintenance, and improvements for Eternl, including frontend and backend maintenance and development, backend infrastructure, user support, day-to-day operations, audits of fund use, and oversight metrics.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 of annual costs for a 12-month period.
The budget is allocated as ₳1,292,500 for frontend, ₳587,500 for backend, ₳117,500 for support, ₳305,500 for admin, and ₳47,000 for audits.
The proposal funds 6.0 FTE across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for companies, and says roughly 5,500 users would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl states it has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs combined.
The proposer says up to $420,000 worth of Ada will be converted into stablecoins in a public company wallet and any Ada above that amount will be returned to the treasury.

The proposer commits to semiannual repayment checks using remaining treasury stablecoins and paid plan income, with surplus used to repay up to $420,000 in Ada and possible additional donations up to $210,000 worth of Ada.

Independent fund-use audits are planned for February 2027 and August 2027 by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team, covering custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and treasury repayments or refunds.
Eternl claims that 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The main Eternl UI will not be open-source, though some Eternl libraries are said to be published through the npm registry.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for a 12-month Eternl sustainability plan administered by Tastenkunst GmbH, with a detailed category budget, proposed Pro-plan revenue path, fund custody and repayment commitments, and fund-use audit plans, but many adoption, feasibility, and impact claims are asserted without embedded evidence.
